transport: HTTPS, or loopback HTTP only for isolated tests

authentication.scope: Current provisioning Project Admin and explicitly assigned projects
authentication.secret_storage: SHA-256 server hash; exclusive OS-user-only local configuration file
authentication.revocation: Rechecked on every input, result and heartbeat request
authentication.redirects: Never followed by the PC client

compatibility.implementation: SHA-256 of evidence and mapping module source bytes with CRLF normalized to LF for Windows/Linux compatibility
compatibility.model: Configured locally installed vision model; identity pinned per job
compatibility.mismatch: HTTP 409 before claim, or reject incompatible result without replacing a checkpoint

endpoints.response: job=null when idle; otherwise job_id, lease, revision_id, snapshot_digest, model, lease_seconds
bounded source or mapping input with immutable input_digest; complete=true after server checklist/drawing preparation
authenticated normalized JPEG bytes with X-Evidence-SHA256

result_rules: Source SHA-256, source ID and selected model must match the server task
Observation schema, count, text lengths, finite values and source references are server-validated
Unknown checklist IDs are withheld; mapping targets must be present in the selected revision catalog
Measurements without explicit recorded evidence/unit are withheld
Source identity, finding keys, measured=false and needs_review are set by Django
Matching duplicate delivery is idempotent; a different checkpoint cannot replace an immutable result
Worker responses cannot contain authoritative file paths, human decisions, accepted answers or releases
recovery: The existing persistent SurveyProcessingJob and SurveySourceAnalysis remain authoritative
Queued jobs wait when the PC is offline
An expired lease is reclaimable and source/mapping checkpoints survive restart
The PC persists a hash-bound result before transmission and quarantines rejected cached results
Server evidence preparation and drawing failures produce an explicit failed job without deleting originals
The existing assigned-Engineer retry action is used for failed survey jobs

errors.409: Incompatible version, immutable-input conflict or invalid result
